_what: How a tool found in a registry is told apart as one that only reads or one that may change something out in the world (src/tool-sources.mjs toolEffectOf). Two signals that do not depend on each other decide: what the registry says about the request itself (`read_only` of the entry, when the source's `entry` names it, or the request's method in `safe_methods`), and the words the tool describes itself with (`write_words`, matched against its label and job). A tool is read only when the first says read and the second finds no write word; one with a write word, or whose request is not a safe one, may change things; one neither signal speaks to is unknown. A tool that is not read only is kept with `invoke.external_effect: true`, so a run that is cut off reads as effect unknown and is never assumed to have done nothing (src/tool-run-owner.mjs). A source can name its own list as `effect_signals` on its row.
